title: config/fleet.json
description: The fleet registry (plan 51 · plan 58, Phase 7): one row per machine, read by hostname by bin/topology.sh, bin/eindri-route.sh, bin/mcp-gateway.sh and bin/model-placement.sh. A registry that names a heart which is not a host, or a host that is not itself, is refused loudly at load. Roles are the fleet's role law: heart (owns the record) · forge (models/GPU) · dev (a full body) · hand (phone).

heart.description: the host that owns the record; must name a row in hosts

hosts.description: hostname -> this machine's row; the machine reads its OWN row
